config.objective: ratio of expected pixel counts with tokenwise posterior; not expected realized IoU
config.optimizer: exact enumeration inside the sealed <=2-operation family
config.fallback: complete FoRIS if excluded reference calibration lacks either role

conditional_selector.name: direction_specific_with_strong_pixel_controls
conditional_selector.objective: maximize RCG-ranked expected IoU; reference gate constrains deletion family only
conditional_selector.direction_policy: p1 ranks additions; p1/p2 both constrain deletions; joint objective is p1 expected I/U
conditional_selector.fallback: unchanged RCG when reference/query anchor calibration is unavailable
conditional_selector.candidate_families: FoRIS/MEAN additions and Astra/MEAN/FoRIS deletions, plus agreement sets

selection: reference-only conditional edit selection; no query labels or DEV fold fitting
